metadata.name: Mesa
metadata.summary: Run Linux applications using the latest bundled Mesa OpenGL and Vulkan graphics drivers

content.value: Mesa AppImage bundles the latest Mesa graphics drivers, including Vulkan and OpenGL implementations, sourced directly from Arch Linux. It allows users to execute any existing system binary using these modern drivers without altering the host distribution's underlying driver installation.
Packaged with sharun and uruntime, this portable package operates seamlessly across diverse Linux environments, providing upgraded graphics support on glibc and musl systems alike.

items.value: Bundles up-to-date Mesa release with Vulkan and OpenGL driver libraries
Wraps and executes any local system application binary with updated graphics drivers
Runs portably without requiring FUSE kernel modules via uruntime
Compatible across virtually all Linux distributions, including musl-based systems
Self-contained driver deployment built without traditional container overhead
